en-US.description:
FamilyPlate helps busy households turn pantry staples into practical dinner plans.

Scan groceries, track pantry items, save favorite recipes, and build grocery lists from the ingredients you are missing. When you want dinner ideas, FamilyPlate can use your pantry, preferences, and recipe history to suggest meals that fit what is already in your kitchen.

Features:

- Pantry tracking for ingredients you already have
- Camera and barcode scanning for faster grocery entry
- AI dinner ideas based on pantry items and household preferences
- Weekly meal planning for family dinners
- Saved cookbook recipes with ingredients and instructions
- Grocery list tools for missing recipe ingredients
- Account deletion, privacy, support, and terms links in Settings

FamilyPlate is not medical advice. Always verify ingredient labels, allergy information, and nutrition details yourself, especially for medical diets, allergies, or food restrictions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

review.notes:
FamilyPlate is an AI meal planning app for households. Reviewers can test pantry tracking with estimated expiration dates, Pantry cook-this-first shortcuts into Tonight, grocery list management, Cookbook, custom family recipes, Recently Cooked, Cook Again planning, Weekly Plan history browsing, Tonight suggestions, shop-first dinner suggestions, post-dinner check-ins, learned meal memory in Settings, camera grocery scanning, barcode scanning, household invite codes, adult invite emails from Settings, pending adult invite status, resend invite emails from the Household card, invite-link sign-in context, native in-app household joining, and App Store subscriptions.

The configured reviewer account is already onboarded with an App Review Household and lands in the main app after sign-in.

AI features show a consent prompt before sending app data to third-party AI providers. Meal planning and photo recognition may send pantry items, grocery photos, household preferences, dietary notes, allergies, and recipe requests to OpenAI to provide the requested app functionality.

In Settings > Eater Profiles, adults now support an optional invite email while child profiles still hide that field. Add an adult profile with a test email address and confirm the success message reflects whether the invite email was sent without blocking the profile save. Then open the Household card, confirm that adult shows Pending invite until they join, and use Resend invite email to send the same household link again.

After you sign out, open that same invite email link. Confirm the mobile sign-in screen still shows the invited household name, inviter, invite code, and the invited adult email address before you sign in or create a second account. If you create a second account from that screen, keep the prefilled invited adult email address so the pending adult profile can be claimed when you join.

If the demo household already has multiple saved weeks, open Weekly Plan and use the header chevrons to move to a past week. Confirm that older dinners open in a read-only history view, then return to Current Week and confirm the active plan is still available for edits without losing the current progress view.

There are no external purchase links shown in the iOS app. FamilyPlate subscriptions are sold through Apple in-app purchase and managed by RevenueCat. Account deletion is available in Settings under Privacy & Account.

The App Store description includes the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Functional Privacy Policy and FamilyPlate Terms links are also available in the app under Settings > Privacy & Account.
